createOrReplace.title: Admissions testing and English - Harvard College
createOrReplace.excerpt: Harvard requires the SAT or ACT to meet its standardized testing requirement. Students lacking access to the SAT or ACT may submit AP or GCSE results, IB/A-level/other national leaving exam predictions or results. Although you are not required to take an English proficiency exam (such as the TOEFL, IELTS, etc.), you may submit scores if you wish to do so.
createOrReplace.retrieval_method: Read in a browser by EvidaPath re-verification pass 2026-11-02

createOrReplace.title: Admissions testing and English - MIT
createOrReplace.excerpt: We require the SAT or the ACT for both prospective first-year and transfer students. For non-native English speakers, we strongly recommend providing the results of an English proficiency exam if you have been using English for fewer than five years ... We do not have cutoff or recommended scores for the ACT or SAT.
createOrReplace.retrieval_method: Read in a browser by EvidaPath re-verification pass 2026-11-02

createOrReplace.title: Admissions testing and English - Stanford University
createOrReplace.excerpt: Is standardized testing (ACT/SAT) required? Yes, the ACT or SAT is required. Are English proficiency exams required? No, we do not require any English proficiency exams.
createOrReplace.retrieval_method: Read in a browser by EvidaPath re-verification pass 2026-11-02

createOrReplace.title: Admissions testing and English - Cornell University
createOrReplace.excerpt: First-year applicants are required to submit SAT or ACT scores when applying to Cornell. Applicants who do not meet one of these criteria [US citizen/PR, native English, English instruction for the past four years] are required to submit an English proficiency exam score ... TOEFL (January 2026 or later) minimum 5.0, recommended 5.5; IELTS minimum 7.5; Duolingo minimum 130.

createOrReplace.title: Admissions testing and English - Princeton University
createOrReplace.excerpt: For first-year and transfer applicants seeking to enroll in fall 2027, Princeton remains test optional. Students who opt to apply to Princeton in 2026-27 cycle without an ACT or SAT score will not be at a disadvantage. First-year and transfer applicants seeking to enroll in fall 2028 will need to submit either SAT or ACT scores.

createOrReplace.title: Admissions testing and English - University of Pennsylvania
createOrReplace.excerpt: Penn applicants are required to submit scores for the SAT or ACT. SAT and ACT Testing Deadlines (2026-2027 Admissions Cycle). No preference is given to the SAT or the ACT.
createOrReplace.retrieval_method: Read in a browser by EvidaPath re-verification pass 2026-11-02

createOrReplace.title: Admissions testing and English - University of Southern California
createOrReplace.excerpt: First-year applicants to the 2027-28 academic year are not required to send SAT or ACT scores to apply. All international applicants whose native language is not English ... must submit a USC-approved English proficiency examination. TOEFL (before 21 January 2026): minimum 100, no less than 20 in each section. IELTS score of 7. 650 on the SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing section. 27 on the ACT English section.

createOrReplace.title: Admissions testing and English - Purdue University
createOrReplace.excerpt: Purdue accepts SAT, ACT and CLT scores; complete application, including an SAT, ACT or CLT test score. IELTS: 6.5 or higher with a minimum score of 6.0 in each section. TOEFL iBT: minimum 88 or higher with at least 20 per section (older scale).

createOrReplace.title: Admissions testing and English - Arizona State University
createOrReplace.excerpt: Have a 3.00 grade point average (GPA) (a 'B' or better where 'A'=4.00) from a secondary school. Some ASU programs may have higher admission or English proficiency requirements. English: Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 79 (4 new scale); All other majors/colleges IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 61 (3.5).

createOrReplace.title: Admissions testing and English - New York University
createOrReplace.excerpt: NYU will continue to remain test-optional through the 2027-2028 application cycle. English language testing: 100 and above on the TOEFL iBT taken on or before January 20, 2026; 5 or above on the TOEFL iBT taken on or after January 21, 2026. NYU does not waive the English language requirements based on SAT, ACT, AP, IGCSE, AS/A-Levels, IB Diploma.
